title: Concept scheme → its name, and when that name is also a document title
description: The bean sl9u rule, declared once so a new emitter READS it rather than rediscovering it (finding D1 of docs/proposals/vocabulary-mappings-2026-10-02.md, bean lodp): a concept scheme that is also a document carries a derived dcterms:title. skos:prefLabel is always the scheme's name. dcterms:title is written only when the scheme's IRI IS the document's (glossary-export's and ns-export's --exact schemes are; a code list's <doc>#<list> and an authored glossary's <ns>glossary/<id> are not), because dcterms:title is what a catalogue reader looks for on a document. The condition is the dependsOn on that row, and the applier refuses a record that does not answer it, so an emitter cannot skip the question by omission. Owner, 2026-09-23, on sl9u: keep both.

additionalAttribute.description: True when the concept scheme's IRI is the IRI of the document that publishes it, so the scheme IS a document. Every emitter applying this table must answer it, true or false.

target.comment: vocabulary-authority: the node is primarily a concept scheme, so skos:prefLabel is authoritative and dcterms:title a derived copy, written only when the scheme is also a document (bean sl9u).
